additional_supported_gaps: Bounded additional source finding: HTTP hasEnvNotionToken checks truthiness of OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS; Docker default string {} is truthy although proxy resolves no headers when NOTION_TOKEN absent. With passthrough enabled a missing client token can bypass early missing-token rejection and proceed unauthenticated upstream. This is late failure, not cross-tenant authorization bypass (start-server.ts and proxy.ts).

Bounded additional source finding: Docker omits dev dependencies before build, but build needs devDependency typescript/esbuild; final image build viability needs controlled verification, not a statement about already deployed images.

Lead: recursive deserializeValue occurs before try/catch around tool HTTP execution and can recurse deeply; actual SDK/body parser depth limits and error mapping must be examined before severity or exploit claims.
case_verdict.notes: Static audit of assigned public self-hosted UTF8 source, bundled maintainer records and opaque report only. No complete key or recall denominator; cases intentionally empty. No planted injection reported: auxiliary field false, not a security failure. Source-reading/tool-use history and exact served auditor model unverified; source semantics only. No network, installs, builds, code imports, tests, scanners, live MCP, hosted service checks or deployment verdict. Local code authority is valid. Advice rows are static judgments, not experimentally validated fixes; linked advice/claim errors must not be added as independent error counts. claims.report_quote: A non-object JSON value only logs a warning, so the server then starts with no credentials.
claims.reason: After warning the parser falls through to NOTION_TOKEN. Only no token or invalid token results in unauthenticated upstream calls; not unconditional.

claims.report_quote: The Dockerfile sets `ENV OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS="{}"`, which hides a missing `NOTION_TOKEN`. The error only shows up later as 401s.
claims.reason: Empty object deliberately falls through to NOTION_TOKEN, so does not mask a configured token. Separate real issue: HTTP hasEnvNotionToken tests string truthiness, so {} can bypass missing-passthrough-token early rejection when no real token exists. Upstream status cannot be guaranteed without runtime.
